// Generator for the v0.2.1 upgrade fixture's ledgers (#138).
//
// The ledgers are written by v0.2.1's own persistence code, not by hand, so
// the fixture is exactly what a v0.2.1 daemon leaves behind. To regenerate:
//
//	git worktree add --detach /tmp/itervox-v021 v0.2.1
//	cp cmd/itervox/testdata/upgrade/v0.2.1/gen_ledgers_test.go.txt \
//	   /tmp/itervox-v021/internal/orchestrator/zz_gen_ledgers_test.go
//	cd /tmp/itervox-v021 && FIXTURE_OUT=<abs path of .../v0.2.1/project> \
//	   go test -run '^TestGenerateUpgradeFixtureLedgers$' ./internal/orchestrator/
//
// WORKFLOW.md and .itervox/agents/ come from v0.2.1's
// `itervox init --tracker github --runner claude` (its .itervox/.env is not
// kept).
package orchestrator

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/vnovick/itervox/internal/outbox"
)

func TestGenerateUpgradeFixtureLedgers(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("FIXTURE_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("FIXTURE_OUT not set")
	}
	logs := filepath.Join(out, "logs")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(logs, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	at := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

	o := &Orchestrator{}
	o.SetPausedFile(filepath.Join(logs, "paused.json"))
	o.SetBackendHealthFile(filepath.Join(logs, "backend_health.json"))
	o.SetPendingReviewsFile(filepath.Join(logs, "pending_reviews.json"))
	o.SetInputRequiredFile(filepath.Join(logs, "input_required.json"))
	o.SetHistoryFile(filepath.Join(logs, "history.json"))
	o.SetHistoryKey("github:owner/repo")

	o.savePausedToDisk(map[string]string{"#7": "7"})
	o.savePauseReasonsToDisk(map[string]string{"#7": "retries_exhausted"})

	state := State{
		BackendHealth: map[string]BackendHealthEntry{
			BackendHealthKey("claude", ""): {
				Backend: "claude", Status: BackendStatusLimited, Kind: "quota",
				LimitType: "five_hour", Source: "rate_limit_event",
				LimitedUntil: time.Date(2099, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), ResetKnown: true,
				Since: at, Hits: 2, LastIssue: "#9",
			},
		},
		PendingReviews: map[string]PendingReview{
			"#11": {IssueID: "11", Identifier: "#11", Profile: "reviewer", QueuedAt: at, IssueState: "in-review"},
		},
	}
	o.saveBackendHealthToDisk(&state)
	o.savePendingReviews(&state)

	o.saveInputRequiredToDisk(map[string]*InputRequiredEntry{
		"#5": {
			IssueID: "5", Identifier: "#5", SessionID: "sess-5", Context: "Which database should I use?",
			Backend: "claude", Command: "claude", ProfileName: "implementer", QueuedAt: at,
		},
	}, nil)

	o.addCompletedRun(CompletedRun{
		Identifier: "#3", Title: "Add a health check", StartedAt: at, FinishedAt: at.Add(10 * time.Minute),
		ElapsedMs: 600000, TurnCount: 12, TotalTokens: 52000, InputTokens: 50000, OutputTokens: 2000,
		Status: "succeeded", Backend: "claude", ProfileName: "implementer", SessionID: "sess-3",
		Kind: "worker", ProjectKey: "github:owner/repo",
	})

	ob, err := outbox.New(filepath.Join(out, ".itervox", "outbox.json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := ob.Enqueue(outbox.Entry{
		Kind: outbox.KindUpdateState, IssueID: "8", Identifier: "#8",
		TargetState: "in-review", FromState: "in-progress", EnqueuedAt: at, NextAttemptAt: at,
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := ob.Enqueue(outbox.Entry{
		Kind: outbox.KindCreateComment, IssueID: "8", Identifier: "#8",
		Body: "Opened a pull request.", CommentKey: "4b1d2c3e-5f60-4718-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b",
		EnqueuedAt: at, NextAttemptAt: at,
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
